{"parentUuid":"c632c39d-2422-4cee-9e90-97253bf7382f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"00fd1af7-4b67-45ee-9a33-1a3c6db1c2e5","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ab1iVmFTCJ2NTQJS2GtDvG","type":"tool_result","content":"The file C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\proposals\\financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"e2de2fe5-18ce-432c-9cf5-c4b71fc1a4d7","timestamp":"2026-05-04T23:47:16.714Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\proposals\\financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md","oldString":"status: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md","newString":"status: ACCEPTED (ratified S43c via D-021; frontmatter sync S43f)","originalFile":"---\nstatus: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\nproposed_at: 2026-04-30\nproposed_by: Claude Opus 4.7 (S26 IMPL — Phase 1 Track B; master-plan 004 § S26 deliverable #1)\nsource_evidence:\n  - PROJECT_CHARTER.md § First Sub-Scope (HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND, position sizing 5-15%, holding 1m-24m)\n  - agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md v1.0 (S25 deliverable; 42 VN terms incl. T+2.5, Room ngoại, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Trần, Sàn, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND)\n  - specs/tier2-feature/000-phase-1-thin-slice-VHM.md § A.3 BR-3 + BR-5 (T+2.5 informational; VND only Phase 1)\n  - agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md Rules 1-10 (existing baseline; this amendment APPENDS Rules 12-15 — Rule 11 reserved for S16 amendment Hook Portability)\n  - docs/DAY_1_CHECKLIST.md § A.4 + § B.1 (financial-data-protocol customization step)\ntarget_constitution_path: agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md\ntarget_section: NEW § \"Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\"\nmove_when: user explicit approve; insertion point = after \"## Rule 10: Backtest Reproducibility\" and before \"## Quick Reference Table\"\nrelates_to:\n  - financial-data-protocol-amendment.md (S16 — Rule 11 Hook Portability; ORTHOGONAL to this amendment, NOT a fold)\n  - invariants-amendment-VN.md (S26 sibling — I-S55-I-S65 invariants enforce these Rules)\n---\n\n# Financial Data Protocol Amendment — Vietnam-Domain Rules 12-15\n\n> **Status**: PROPOSAL pending user approve. Codifies VN-specific data integrity rules that emerged from glossary v1.0 (S25) and Phase 1 thin-slice spec (S25). Each Rule names existing glossary terms by exact spelling and references invariants-amendment-VN.md for enforcement.\n>\n> **Why these Rules and not others**: glossary v1.0 surfaced 8 critical VN-domain terms (T+2.5, Room ngoại, Đội lái, Mua chủ động, Bán chủ động, Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Phiên ATO/ATC, Tỷ giá USD/VND). Rules 12-15 cover the 4 that are data-integrity-binding for Phase 1+ (settlement timing, foreign-cap detection, sàn-tier data quality, FX point-in-time). Đội lái + Mua/Bán chủ động + ATO/ATC are Phase 2+ (intraday + Tier 4 work) — deferred.\n\n## Append to `financial-data-protocol.md` (NEW section, after Rule 10)\n\n---\n\n## Rule 12 — T+2.5 Settlement Timing Awareness\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN equities settle T+2.5 (trade date + 2.5 trading days). A buy on Monday clears Wednesday afternoon; cash from a Monday sell is re-investable Wednesday afternoon. Backtests that ignore T+2.5 over-count compoundable cash by 2-3 trading days, producing false-positive performance especially for high-turnover strategies.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Position` entity tracks `opened_at` = trade-match date (NOT cleared-cash date).\n- Every cash-flow record carries `cleared_at = opened_at + T+2.5 trading days` (computed via VN trading calendar, not naive +3 calendar days).\n- Backtest re-investment available cash queries: `WHERE cleared_at <= action_date`.\n- Live cash queries may use `cleared_at <= today` for pre-trade checks; cash gating in `apps/cli/order_*.py` (Phase 2+) MUST consult cleared cash, not trade-match cash.\n- Phase 1 thin-slice exception: `Position.opened_at` is required, but T+2.5 cash gating is NOT enforced (deferred to Phase 2 when intraday/order-management lands per spec 000 § BR-5).\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`PositionRepository.compute_cleared_cash(as_of_date)` is the only path for re-investable cash. No `available_cash()` method bypasses T+2.5. CI gate (Phase 2+) adds property test: random portfolio + random sell timing, assert `cleared_at - opened_at` always ≥2.5 trading days per VN calendar.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 13 — Room Ngoại (Foreign-Ownership Cap) Detection\n\n### The Problem\n\nForeign investors face a hard ceiling on per-stock ownership in VN equities. The cap is sector-dependent: banking ≤30%, real estate ≤49%, most industrial ≤49% with stock-specific overrides. When a stock saturates Room ngoại, foreign buy-pressure cannot accumulate further — the stock is effectively closed to foreign-flow signal until domestic holders sell to foreigners. Strategies that key on \"foreign accumulation\" silently fail on saturated stocks. Strategies that pump on \"Room ngoại near full\" (early signal of further foreign demand) miss the regime.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Bar` (BC-1) carries `foreign_buy_volume` + `foreign_sell_volume` (existing schema per architecture.md BC-1).\n- NEW per-Ticker daily snapshot record `ForeignOwnershipState`: `(ticker, date, foreign_owned_shares, foreign_cap_shares, saturation_pct, source_provider, ingested_at, as_of)`.\n- `saturation_pct = foreign_owned_shares / foreign_cap_shares`. When `saturation_pct >= 0.95`, the stock is in saturation regime — foreign-flow analysis must explicitly mark this.\n- Source provenance: HOSE listed-stocks portal + vnstock `room_ngoai()` endpoint + TCBS reconciliation per Rule 4. Rule 4 reconciliation tolerance = 1% of cap (NOT 1% of saturation_pct — different denominators).\n- Backtest queries on foreign accumulation MUST filter `WHERE saturation_pct < 0.95 OR explicit_saturation_strategy = TRUE`.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`ForeignOwnershipRepository` Protocol: `get_state_as_of(ticker, as_of_date)` + `get_saturated_universe(as_of_date, threshold=0.95)`. Bar+ForeignOwnership join in `MarketDataReadModel` denormalized view. Phase 1 thin-slice on VHM does NOT seed ForeignOwnership data (Phase 2 deliverable when full VN30 ingestion lands); Bar.foreign_buy / foreign_sell fields are seeded but Saturation analysis deferred.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 14 — Sàn HOSE / HNX / UPCoM Data-Quality Tiering\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN listed equities split across 3 exchanges (Sàn): HOSE (HCMC; tier-1 large caps; strictest disclosure), HNX (Hanoi; tier-2; mid-caps), UPCoM (over-the-counter board; tier-3; micro-caps + pre-listing transitional). Data quality, filing cadence, and cross-source reconciliation tolerance differ by Sàn. Treating UPCoM Bars with the same trust as HOSE Bars produces false-positive backtest signals on noisy UPCoM data.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- Every `Ticker` value object infers Sàn at construction (regex on listing-status feed: 3-letter alpha → HOSE; 3-letter alpha + HNX flag → HNX; UPCoM has explicit ticker namespace).\n- Every `Bar` carries `sàn` field (NEW; values: HOSE | HNX | UPCoM). Field is denormalized from Ticker for query performance (Rule 4 reconciliation runs per-Sàn).\n- Reconciliation tolerance per Rule 4 is Sàn-tiered:\n  - HOSE: ±1% (existing tolerance preserved)\n  - HNX: ±2% (mid-cap, slightly noisier filings)\n  - UPCoM: ±5% (micro-cap, frequent stale data; Sàn-tier downgrade flag mandatory)\n- Phase 1 thin-slice scope locks to HOSE only (VHM is HOSE; spec 000 § A.5 Out-of-Scope item 4).\n- Charter \"First Sub-Scope\" mid-cap band (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) implicitly excludes most UPCoM stocks; this Rule codifies the data-quality reason.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`Bar.__post_init__` validates `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}`. `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance. Backtest universe construction (per Rule 2) MUST tag `Sàn` per row; CI gate (Phase 2+) warns if backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier-aware logic.\n\n---\n\n## Rule 15 — FX VND-USD Point-in-Time Discipline\n\n### The Problem\n\nVN equities are priced VND. Some thesis comparisons reference USD-denominated peers (e.g., regional comparable PE). FX rates VND/USD drift 1-3% per quarter and 5-8% per year. A naive \"as_of FX rate\" lookup using today's rate to convert a 2024-Q1 metric distorts comparable analysis silently. Rule 5 already mandates explicit `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_rate)`; Rule 15 codifies VN specifics and the FX rate source-attribution discipline.\n\n### The Rule\n\n- FX rates VND/USD (and any other pair) stored as `FxRate(currency_pair, as_of_date, rate, source_provider, ingested_at)` records per Rule 1 point-in-time integrity.\n- `source_provider` for FX MUST be one of: `SBV` (Tỷ giá trung tâm State Bank of Vietnam — official reference rate) | `VCB` (Vietcombank cash quote) | `VNSTOCK` (vnstock historical FX endpoint, derived from interbank). NEVER LLM-extracted (I-S1).\n- `Money.convert(target_currency, as_of_date)` resolves FX via `FxRateRepository.get_as_of(currency_pair, as_of_date)` — NOT current-day rate. If as_of_date pre-dates earliest stored FX rate, raise `FxRateNotAvailableError` (do NOT fallback to nearest); this preserves Rule 1 integrity at the FX layer.\n- Backtest cross-currency: every conversion call records `(amount_native, amount_target, fx_rate_used, fx_as_of_date, fx_source)` for audit reproducibility per Rule 10.\n- Phase 1 thin-slice: VND only (spec 000 § BR-3); FX subsystem stubbed but unused.\n\n### The Enforcement\n\n`Money.convert()` raises if FX rate unavailable for as_of_date. `FxRateRepository.get_as_of()` enforces point-in-time. CI test (Phase 2+): backtest with deliberate cross-currency comparison runs twice with same `(commit, snapshot, config, seed)` and produces identical converted values per Rule 10 reproducibility.\n\n---\n\n## Why Rules 12-15 Are Phase-1-Compatible Even Though Phase 1 Doesn't Enforce Them\n\nRules 12-15 are codified now to anchor S27-S28 entity design (Bar.sàn field, Position.opened_at semantics, FX placeholder structure) so Phase 2 enforcement layers slot into existing types without retrofitting. This matches Charter \"When in doubt, simplify\" + \"Ship thin slices\" — types are designed once, enforcement layers ship phase-by-phase.\n\n## End of amendment\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":5,"newStart":1,"newLines":5,"lines":[" ---","-status: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md","+status: ACCEPTED (ratified S43c via D-021; frontmatter sync S43f)"," proposed_at: 2026-04-30"," proposed_by: Claude Opus 4.7 (S26 IMPL — Phase 1 Track B; master-plan 004 § S26 deliverable #1)"," source_evidence:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c632c39d-2422-4cee-9e90-97253bf7382f","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

Phase 2+ = scaffold + binding deferred until intraday/full-VN30/cash-mgmt land\"\n---\n\n# Invariants Amendment — Vietnam-Domain I-S55 through I-S65\n\n> **Status**: PROPOSAL pending user approve. 11 NEW stock-specific invariants enforcing financial-data-protocol-amendment-VN.md Rules 12-15. Each entry: ID + name + binding statement + enforcement + binding_phase.\n>\n> **Why 11 not 10**: master-plan 004 § S26 enumerated 11 distinct concerns (T+2.5 / foreign-room / ATO-ATC / dividend ex-date / listing-status / lot-size / ceiling-floor / suspension / ex-rights / reconciliation-tolerance / fallback-chain) — codified faithfully even though master-plan abstract count said \"10\". Better to ship 11 honestly than cherry-pick.\n\n## Append to `invariants.md` § ⭐ Stock-Specific Data Integrity (after I-S54)\n\n---\n\n### I-S55: T+2.5 Cleared Cash Re-Investability\n\nCash from a sell trade is re-investable only after T+2.5 trading days clear (VN settlement convention). Backtest re-investment logic must consult `Position.cleared_at`, not `opened_at`.\n\n**Enforcement**: `PositionRepository.compute_cleared_cash(as_of_date)` is the only path. `available_cash()` shortcut method forbidden. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (when intraday + cash management land); Phase 1 thin-slice tracks `opened_at` only without cash gating per spec 000 § BR-5.\n\n### I-S56: Foreign-Room Saturation Alert\n\nWhen `ForeignOwnershipState.saturation_pct >= 0.95` for a Ticker, foreign-flow signal interpretation MUST explicitly mark saturation regime. Strategies keying on \"foreign accumulation\" silently fail on saturated stocks.\n\n**Enforcement**: `ForeignOwnershipRepository.get_saturated_universe(as_of_date)` returns Tickers with saturation ≥0.95. Alert pipeline (Phase 2+) emits `SaturationRegimeWarning` event before any foreign-flow-keyed signal is rendered. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (full VN30 ingestion seeds ForeignOwnership data).\n\n### I-S57: Phiên ATO / ATC Phase Identification\n\nIntraday Bars from VN exchanges include Phiên ATO (At-The-Open auction; opening price discovery) + Phiên ATC (At-The-Close auction; closing price discovery). These auction-phase trades have non-continuous price formation; technical indicators that assume continuous trading misfire on ATO/ATC bars.\n\n**Enforcement**: Intraday Bar entity (Phase 2+) carries `phase ∈ {PRE_OPEN, ATO, CONTINUOUS, ATC, POST_CLOSE}`. Indicator calculations in BC-8 must filter or weight ATO/ATC bars per indicator semantics. **Binding phase**: Phase 2+ (Phase 1 thin-slice = EOD only; no intraday).\n\n### I-S58: Dividend Ex-Date Adjustment (VN Convention)\n\nVN dividends declare ex-date as last day stockholder is entitled to dividend (NOT first day price drops). Some sources report ex-date as next trading day. Mismatched ex-date → adjusted-price errors of 5-15% on dividend day.\n\n**Enforcement**: `DividendEvent` records `ex_date` (last-entitled day) + `pay_date` (cash distribution day) + `ex_date_source_convention ∈ {VN_LAST_ENTITLED, ALT_FIRST_DROP}`. Adjustment logic per Rule 3 always uses VN_LAST_ENTITLED + 1 trading day as the adjustment-effective date. Reconciliation between sources MUST normalize convention before comparison. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (dataclass scaffold) + Phase 2 enforcement (when full corporate-actions feed lands).\n\n### I-S59: Listing-Status Sàn Tagging\n\nEvery Ticker carries `sàn ∈ {HOSE, HNX, UPCoM}` resolved at construction. Mixing Sàn in backtest universe without tier-aware logic is bug.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Ticker.__post_init__` validates `sàn` non-null. `Bar.sàn` denormalized from Ticker for query speed. Universe construction (per Rule 2) tags every row with `sàn`. CI warning (Phase 2+) when backtest dataset mixes Sàn without explicit tier handling. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (scaffold + Bar field); Phase 2 enforcement.\n\n### I-S60: Lot-Size 100-Share Rule\n\nVN equities trade in lots of 100 shares (HOSE/HNX standard); odd-lot trades route to Sở giao dịch lô lẻ (separate market with different price discovery). Backtests that allow fractional or 1-share orders silently model unrealistic execution.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Order.quantity` validation: `quantity % 100 == 0` for round-lot path; `OddLotOrder` separate type for the lô lẻ path. Position-sizing (per Rule 11 risk-rule) rounds DOWN to nearest 100 shares. **Binding phase**: Phase 2 (when order management lands); Phase 1 Position quantity is informational only.\n\n### I-S61: Ceiling / Floor (Trần / Sàn) Per-Sàn Limits\n\nDaily price ceiling/floor (Trần/Sàn glossary terms) differ per Sàn: HOSE ±7%, HNX ±10%, UPCoM ±15% from prior reference price. Trades at ceiling/floor have non-continuous pricing (queue-based fills); backtest assumptions of continuous fillability fail.\n\n**Enforcement**: `Bar.is_at_ceiling()` + `is_at_floor()` methods (computed: `close == reference_price * (1 + sàn_limit_pct)` within rounding tolerance). Backtest fillability check (Phase 2+): if order price = ceiling/floor, model partial fill probability per Sàn. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (Bar method scaffold) + Phase 2 fillability modeling.\n\n### I-S62: Trading-Suspension Event Handling\n\nVN exchanges suspend trading on individual Tickers (regulatory + compliance reasons; minutes to days to permanent). Backtests on suspended Tickers must skip or mark-to-last-trade (NOT extrapolate). Live thesis output on suspended stock must surface suspension status.\n\n**Enforcement**: `SuspensionEvent(ticker, started_at, ended_at_or_null, reason)` records. Bar query layer skips suspension windows for return calc; thesis output includes `suspension_status` field. **Binding phase**: Phase 2+ (suspension feed not in Phase 1 thin-slice).\n\n### I-S63: Corporate-Action Ex-Rights Tagging\n\nBeyond dividends + splits, VN corporate actions include rights issues (quyền mua), bonus shares (cổ phiếu thưởng), and capital adjustments. Ex-rights date carries adjustment math distinct from ex-dividend.\n\n**Enforcement**: `CorporateAction` aggregate covers `{DIVIDEND, SPLIT, RIGHTS_ISSUE, BONUS_SHARES, CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT}`. Adjustment-type tagging per Rule 3 extended: `adjustment_type ∈ {NONE, DIVIDEND, SPLIT, BOTH, RIGHTS, BONUS, CAPITAL}`. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 enum scaffold + Phase 2 corporate-actions feed integration.\n\n### I-S64: vnstock vs TCBS Reconciliation Tolerance Sàn-Tiered\n\nPer Rule 14, reconciliation tolerance is Sàn-tiered: HOSE ±1%, HNX ±2%, UPCoM ±5%. Single tolerance across Sàn produces false-flag noise on UPCoM and missed-divergence on HOSE.\n\n**Enforcement**: `ReconciliationService.tolerance_for(bar)` returns Sàn-tier tolerance; existing `RECONCILIATION_TOLERANCE_PCT` constant DEPRECATED (kept for backward compat, raises DeprecationWarning). **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (S28 ReconciliationService implementation must consume `tolerance_for(bar)` from inception).\n\n### I-S65: Source-Fallback Chain Order\n\nWhen primary data source is unavailable, fallback chain is deterministic: vnstock → TCBS → Vietstock public → Manual. Manual override must document `override_reason` (per Rule 4). KOL-extracted numbers NEVER appear in this chain (I-S1 — no LLM math).\n\n**Enforcement**: `BarProvider.fetch_with_fallback(ticker, date_range)` consults chain in order; emits `SourceFallbackEvent` when non-primary source returned. Audit log records every fallback for Rule 10 reproducibility. **Binding phase**: Phase 1 (S28 vnstock primary + TCBS backup; Vietstock + Manual deferred Phase 2).\n\n---\n\n## Coverage Map: Rules 12-15 ↔ Invariants I-S55-I-S65\n\n| Rule | Enforced by |\n|---|---|\n| Rule 12 (T+2.5 settlement) | I-S55 cleared-cash re-investability |\n| Rule 13 (Room ngoại) | I-S56 foreign-room saturation alert |\n| Rule 14 (Sàn HOSE/HNX/UPCoM tiering) | I-S59 sàn tagging + I-S64 sàn-tier reconciliation |\n| Rule 15 (FX VND-USD point-in-time) | (covered by existing Rule 5 + I-S6; no new I-S* needed) |\n\nI-S57 (ATO/ATC), I-S58 (dividend ex-date), I-S60 (lot-size), I-S61 (ceiling/floor), I-S62 (suspension), I-S63 (ex-rights) anchor Phase 2 work on Bar/Order/CorporateAction types — codified now so Phase 2 enforcement slots into existing scaffolds.\n\n## End of amendment\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":5,"newStart":1,"newLines":5,"lines":[" ---","-status: PROPOSAL — AMENDMENT to existing agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md","+status: ACCEPTED (ratified S43c via D-022; frontmatter sync S43f)"," proposed_at: 2026-04-30"," proposed_by: Claude Opus 4.7 (S26 IMPL — Phase 1 Track B; master-plan 004 § S26 deliverable #2)"," source_evidence:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8d48c8ab-c2c1-4eb9-b5ae-79f51cafd9cb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

Emits SessionStart soft advisory recommending\n# bundled deny-lift cycle (1 lift + N edits + 1 restore + 1 combined ADR) to\n# amortize permission ceremony cost.\n#\n# Decision basis: D-026 § \"Why bundled\" + agent-notes L-S43f-1 (2026-05-05).\n# Anti-pattern prevented: sequencing N separate cycles when bundling is correct.\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1.\n# SessionStart hook (matcher startup|resume|clear); soft-warn (exit 0).\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nPROP_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/proposals\"\nLOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds)\"\n\n[ -d \"$PROP_DIR\" ] || exit 0\n\n# Count proposals whose first 20 lines contain status: PROPOSAL or status: PROPOSED\n# (not ACCEPTED, REJECTED, AMENDED). Inline `**Status**: PROPOSAL` form also matched.\nPENDING=0\nTARGETS=\"\"\nfor f in \"$PROP_DIR\"/*.md; do\n  [ -f \"$f\" ] || continue\n  head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '^(status:|.\\*\\*Status.*:.\\*).*(PROPOSAL|PROPOSED)' || continue\n  # Skip if already shows ACCEPTED/REJECTED/AMENDED (safer double-check)\n  head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '(ACCEPTED|REJECTED|AMENDED|RATIFIED)' && continue\n  PENDING=$((PENDING + 1))\n  TARGETS=\"$TARGETS $(basename \"$f\")\"\ndone\n\nif [ \"$PENDING\" -ge 2 ]; then\n  ADVISORY=\"proposal-bundle-advisor: $PENDING charter-tier proposals currently pending. Consider bundled deny-lift cycle (single AskUserQuestion + single permission lift + 1 combined ADR) per L-S43f-1 / D-026 precedent. Pending:$TARGETS\"\n  printf '[%s] %s\\n' \"$TS\" \"$ADVISORY\" >> \"$LOG\"\n  echo \"$ADVISORY\" >&2\nelse\n  printf '[%s] proposal-bundle-advisor: pending=%s (no bundling opportunity)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$PENDING\" >> \"$LOG\"\nfi\n\nexit 0\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":6,"cache_creation_input_tokens":178,"cache_read_input_tokens":141172,"output_tokens":1999,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":178,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":6,"output_tokens":1999,"cache_read_input_tokens":141172,"cache_creation_input_tokens":178,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":178},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaiRWGpHn2RNHh4TUMDy5","type":"assistant","uuid":"00c961d3-842c-487e-910b-36daf3472622","timestamp":"2026-05-04T23:48:33.787Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

Emits SessionStart soft advisory recommending\n# bundled deny-lift cycle (1 lift + N edits + 1 restore + 1 combined ADR) to\n# amortize permission ceremony cost.\n#\n# Decision basis: D-026 § \"Why bundled\" + agent-notes L-S43f-1 (2026-05-05).\n# Anti-pattern prevented: sequencing N separate cycles when bundling is correct.\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1.\n# SessionStart hook (matcher startup|resume|clear); soft-warn (exit 0).\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nPROP_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/proposals\"\nLOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds)\"\n\n[ -d \"$PROP_DIR\" ] || exit 0\n\n# Count proposals whose first 20 lines contain status: PROPOSAL or status: PROPOSED\n# (not ACCEPTED, REJECTED, AMENDED). Inline `**Status**: PROPOSAL` form also matched.\nPENDING=0\nTARGETS=\"\"\nfor f in \"$PROP_DIR\"/*.md; do\n  [ -f \"$f\" ] || continue\n  head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '^(status:|.\\*\\*Status.*:.\\*).*(PROPOSAL|PROPOSED)' || continue\n  # Skip if already shows ACCEPTED/REJECTED/AMENDED (safer double-check)\n  head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '(ACCEPTED|REJECTED|AMENDED|RATIFIED)' && continue\n  PENDING=$((PENDING + 1))\n  TARGETS=\"$TARGETS $(basename \"$f\")\"\ndone\n\nif [ \"$PENDING\" -ge 2 ]; then\n  ADVISORY=\"proposal-bundle-advisor: $PENDING charter-tier proposals currently pending. Consider bundled deny-lift cycle (single AskUserQuestion + single permission lift + 1 combined ADR) per L-S43f-1 / D-026 precedent. Pending:$TARGETS\"\n  printf '[%s] %s\\n' \"$TS\" \"$ADVISORY\" >> \"$LOG\"\n  echo \"$ADVISORY\" >&2\nelse\n  printf '[%s] proposal-bundle-advisor: pending=%s (no bundling opportunity)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$PENDING\" >> \"$LOG\"\nfi\n\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":28,"oldLines":8,"newStart":28,"newLines":9,"lines":[" TARGETS=\"\""," for f in \"$PROP_DIR\"/*.md; do","   [ -f \"$f\" ] || continue","-  head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '^(status:|.\\*\\*Status.*:.\\*).*(PROPOSAL|PROPOSED)' || continue","-  # Skip if already shows ACCEPTED/REJECTED/AMENDED (safer double-check)","+  # Match YAML frontmatter (status: PROPOSAL) OR inline markdown (**Status**: PROPOSAL).","+  head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '(^status:|\\*\\*Status\\*\\*:)\\s*(PROPOSAL|PROPOSED)' || continue","+  # Skip if same head also shows ACCEPTED/REJECTED/AMENDED/RATIFIED (safer double-check).","   head -n 20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE '(ACCEPTED|REJECTED|AMENDED|RATIFIED)' && continue","   PENDING=$((PENDING + 1))","   TARGETS=\"$TARGETS $(basename \"$f\")\""]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"53f7d66f-4aef-430d-a6c3-ef27a72bf24a","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"c49cbb0e-b66e-41e7-a182-23d4c1ef1c79","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"224e6210-a586-4efc-94ed-dc5e1327c6d1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BANGTZqpbEqGy9zac3Th8U","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t---\n2\tspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-23-002\n3\ttier: 2\n4\tstatus: approved\n5\tversion: 1.0\n6\tcreated: 2026-04-23\n7\tauthors: [project-owner]\n8\tbounded_contexts: [Influence Network, Calibration]\n9\trelated_specs: [SPEC-2026-04-23-T1-001, SPEC-2026-04-23-004, SPEC-2026-04-23-005]\n10\tubiquitous_language_terms: [KOL, Channel, Recommendation, Credibility Score, Calibration, Outcome Review, Bayesian Update, Confluence, Pumper]\n11\t---\n12\t\n13\t# SPEC: Influence Network Tracking System (BC-6)\n14\t\n15\t> Implements Tier 3 of the four-tier signal architecture.\n16\t> The single most edge-creating component for the Vietnamese market.\n17\t\n18\t---\n19\t\n20\t# PART A — BUSINESS SPECIFICATION\n21\t\n22\t## A.1 Context & Opportunity\n23\t\n24\tIn Vietnam stock market, KOLs (YouTube channels, Facebook influencers, podcast hosts, personal blogs) **measurably move prices**. Some KOL recommendations precede 3-7% moves within days. Others are inverse indicators (their recommendations often mark tops).\n25\t\n26\t**The problem**: no way to know which KOLs to trust until you've watched them for years and remembered their calls. Retail investors typically follow the loudest voice or the most recent video, leading to poor outcomes.\n27\t\n28\t**The opportunity**: systematically track every KOL's recommendations + outcomes, building a calibration database that scores credibility per KOL, per sector, per timeframe. After 6-12 months, this becomes proprietary data no one can replicate without starting equally early.\n29\t\n30\t**Why this is proprietary**: US/global quant funds don't do this because the KOL ecosystem doesn't affect efficient markets. Vietnam commercial products (FiinPro, Wichart) don't do it because it's labor-intensive — exactly what LLMs now solve at scale.\n31\t\n32\t## A.2 Core Use Cases\n33\t\n34\t**UC-1 Daily Digest** — Daily 21:00 summary of all new recommendations from tracked KOLs, sorted by credibility, with flip alerts.\n35\t\n36\t**UC-2 Per-Ticker Sentiment** — \"Show me all KOL recommendations on HPG last 30 days\" → chronological list weighted by credibility, disagreement flagged.\n37\t\n38\t**UC-3 Confluence Detection** — Alert when ≥3 high-credibility KOLs converge on same ticker within 7 days.\n39\t\n40\t**UC-4 Calibration Inspection** — Browse each KOL's track record: overall/sector/timeframe hit rates, Bayesian CI, recent hits/misses.\n41\t\n42\t**UC-5 Pump Operator Detection** — Warn when known pumper (high frequency of recommendations that subsequently dump) pushes a stock.\n43\t\n44\t## A.3 Business Rules\n45\t\n46\t**BR-1 Public Only** — Data sourced exclusively from public channels (YouTube public videos, public Facebook fanpages, public Telegram broadcast channels, public podcasts, public blogs). Never private groups, never paid leaks.\n47\t\n48\t**BR-2 Calibration Required** — Every KOL has credibility score before counted in confluence. New KOLs \"provisional\" until 10 evaluated recommendations.\n49\t\n50\t**BR-3 Outcome Tracking Mandatory** — Every extracted recommendation gets scheduled reviews at 1m/3m/6m/12m. Reviews run automatically when due."}]},"uuid":"6d32052a-e691-482d-bce5-406d81417fe2","timestamp":"2026-05-04T23:58:43.536Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\specs\\tier2-feature\\002-influence-network-tracking.md","content":"---\nspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-23-002\ntier: 2\nstatus: approved\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: 2026-04-23\nauthors: [project-owner]\nbounded_contexts: [Influence Network, Calibration]\nrelated_specs: [SPEC-2026-04-23-T1-001, SPEC-2026-04-23-004, SPEC-2026-04-23-005]\nubiquitous_language_terms: [KOL, Channel, Recommendation, Credibility Score, Calibration, Outcome Review, Bayesian Update, Confluence, Pumper]\n---\n\n# SPEC: Influence Network Tracking System (BC-6)\n\n> Implements Tier 3 of the four-tier signal architecture.\n> The single most edge-creating component for the Vietnamese market.\n\n---\n\n# PART A — BUSINESS SPECIFICATION\n\n## A.1 Context & Opportunity\n\nIn Vietnam stock market, KOLs (YouTube channels, Facebook influencers, podcast hosts, personal blogs) **measurably move prices**. Some KOL recommendations precede 3-7% moves within days. Others are inverse indicators (their recommendations often mark tops).\n\n**The problem**: no way to know which KOLs to trust until you've watched them for years and remembered their calls. Retail investors typically follow the loudest voice or the most recent video, leading to poor outcomes.\n\n**The opportunity**: systematically track every KOL's recommendations + outcomes, building a calibration database that scores credibility per KOL, per sector, per timeframe. After 6-12 months, this becomes proprietary data no one can replicate without starting equally early.\n\n**Why this is proprietary**: US/global quant funds don't do this because the KOL ecosystem doesn't affect efficient markets. Vietnam commercial products (FiinPro, Wichart) don't do it because it's labor-intensive — exactly what LLMs now solve at scale.\n\n## A.2 Core Use Cases\n\n**UC-1 Daily Digest** — Daily 21:00 summary of all new recommendations from tracked KOLs, sorted by credibility, with flip alerts.\n\n**UC-2 Per-Ticker Sentiment** — \"Show me all KOL recommendations on HPG last 30 days\" → chronological list weighted by credibility, disagreement flagged.\n\n**UC-3 Confluence Detection** — Alert when ≥3 high-credibility KOLs converge on same ticker within 7 days.\n\n**UC-4 Calibration Inspection** — Browse each KOL's track record: overall/sector/timeframe hit rates, Bayesian CI, recent hits/misses.\n\n**UC-5 Pump Operator Detection** — Warn when known pumper (high frequency of recommendations that subsequently dump) pushes a stock.\n\n## A.3 Business Rules\n\n**BR-1 Public Only** — Data sourced exclusively from public channels (YouTube public videos, public Facebook fanpages, public Telegram broadcast channels, public podcasts, public blogs). Never private groups, never paid leaks.\n\n**BR-2 Calibration Required** — Every KOL has credibility score before counted in confluence. {"parentUuid":"6d32052a-e691-482d-bce5-406d81417fe2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_014tH1DiPX9XqUr96sJaixyz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GEgMAcxnkuKeRXJeMnAJDv","name":"Read","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\specs\\tier2-feature\\003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md","limit":50},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":6,"cache_creation_input_tokens":237,"cache_read_input_tokens":157646,"output_tokens":1437,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":237,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":6,"output_tokens":1437,"cache_read_input_tokens":157646,"cache_creation_input_tokens":237,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":237},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaiSHpjfkZsepCaSDAEWw","type":"assistant","uuid":"4fb72df9-73a1-4a0c-adad-cc11d105d63c","timestamp":"2026-05-04T23:58:43.901Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"4fb72df9-73a1-4a0c-adad-cc11d105d63c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"224e6210-a586-4efc-94ed-dc5e1327c6d1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GEgMAcxnkuKeRXJeMnAJDv","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t---\n2\tspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-23-003\n3\ttier: 2\n4\tstatus: approved\n5\tversion: 1.0\n6\tcreated: 2026-04-23\n7\tauthors: [project-owner]\n8\tbounded_contexts: [Crowd Sentiment]\n9\trelated_specs: [SPEC-2026-04-23-T1-001, SPEC-2026-04-23-004]\n10\tubiquitous_language_terms: [Crowd Sentiment, Narrative, Narrative Phase, Pump Phase, Coordination Score, Mention Velocity, Posting Pattern, FOMO, Distribution, Counter-Narrative]\n11\t---\n12\t\n13\t# SPEC: Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (BC-7)\n14\t\n15\t> Implements Tier 4 of the four-tier signal architecture.\n16\t> Most Vietnam-specific edge — no commercial product tracks crowd behavior at this depth.\n17\t\n18\t---\n19\t\n20\t# PART A — BUSINESS SPECIFICATION\n21\t\n22\t## A.1 Context\n23\t\n24\tVietnam stock market has an active online retail community: F319 forum, Facebook public groups with 50K-500K members, Telegram channels, comment sections on CafeF/Vietstock. This community's collective behavior follows patterns:\n25\t\n26\t- **Narratives have lifecycles** (incubation → emerging → mainstream → saturation → exhaustion → reversal). Trading the narrative at right phase = alpha; buying at saturation = losses.\n27\t\n28\t- **Pumps follow signatures**. Pump operators (\"đội lái\") don't vary their playbook much: quiet accumulation → narrative seeding through proxy accounts → sudden volume + price spike → KOL amplification → retail FOMO → distribution → dump. Each phase has detectable features.\n29\t\n30\t- **Coordinated posting is detectable**. Same talking points, similar phrasing, clustered timing across supposedly independent accounts = coordinated messaging. LLMs can detect this at scale that humans cannot.\n31\t\n32\t- **Crowd sentiment LAGS price**. By the time community is euphoric, the move is often 80% done. By the time despair sets in, bottom often forming. Sentiment is **timing signal for narrative phases**, not directional signal.\n33\t\n34\tMajor commercial products (FiinPro, Wichart, Stockbiz) don't provide this. It's labor-intensive and requires Vietnamese NLP — exactly what LLMs now enable.\n35\t\n36\t## A.2 Core Use Cases\n37\t\n38\t**UC-1 Pump Warning** — Alert when ticker shows pump signature: alert specifies suspected phase (pre-pump / pump / distribution / dump) with contributing signals and recommended action (avoid / exit / continue watching).\n39\t\n40\t**UC-2 Narrative Tracking** — Track narratives (e.g., \"đầu tư công 2026\", \"ngành thép phục hồi\") through lifecycle phases. Alert when narrative reaches saturation (likely top forming).\n41\t\n42\t**UC-3 Counter-Narrative Generator** — When a ticker reaches high sentiment (>80% bullish community), system auto-generates counter-narrative: what if this is wrong, what are bear cases, historical similar setups that failed.\n43\t\n44\t**UC-4 Sentiment Momentum on Watchlist** — Daily: which of my watchlist stocks have meaningful sentiment changes? (Crowd suddenly notices = late; crowd turning negative on one I own = signal.)\n45\t\n46\t**UC-5 FOMO Detection** — Detect when I'm about to FOMO — if I'm querying a ticker that's currently in saturation phase with high pump signals, system reminds me of pattern.\n47\t\n48\t## A.3 Business Rules\n49\t\n50\t**BR-1 Public Only** — Forums (F319 public section), public Facebook groups (non-restricted), public Telegram channels, article comments. **NEVER private groups, never Zalo private, never DMs.**"}]},"uuid":"b44cfe79-7159-4555-ac8c-8410bf5219f6","timestamp":"2026-05-04T23:58:44.364Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\specs\\tier2-feature\\003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md","content":"---\nspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-23-003\ntier: 2\nstatus: approved\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: 2026-04-23\nauthors: [project-owner]\nbounded_contexts: [Crowd Sentiment]\nrelated_specs: [SPEC-2026-04-23-T1-001, SPEC-2026-04-23-004]\nubiquitous_language_terms: [Crowd Sentiment, Narrative, Narrative Phase, Pump Phase, Coordination Score, Mention Velocity, Posting Pattern, FOMO, Distribution, Counter-Narrative]\n---\n\n# SPEC: Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (BC-7)\n\n> Implements Tier 4 of the four-tier signal architecture.\n> Most Vietnam-specific edge — no commercial product tracks crowd behavior at this depth.\n\n---\n\n# PART A — BUSINESS SPECIFICATION\n\n## A.1 Context\n\nVietnam stock market has an active online retail community: F319 forum, Facebook public groups with 50K-500K members, Telegram channels, comment sections on CafeF/Vietstock. This community's collective behavior follows patterns:\n\n- **Narratives have lifecycles** (incubation → emerging → mainstream → saturation → exhaustion → reversal). Trading the narrative at right phase = alpha; buying at saturation = losses.\n\n- **Pumps follow signatures**. Pump operators (\"đội lái\") don't vary their playbook much: quiet accumulation → narrative seeding through proxy accounts → sudden volume + price spike → KOL amplification → retail FOMO → distribution → dump. Each phase has detectable features.\n\n- **Coordinated posting is detectable**. Same talking points, similar phrasing, clustered timing across supposedly independent accounts = coordinated messaging. LLMs can detect this at scale that humans cannot.\n\n- **Crowd sentiment LAGS price**. By the time community is euphoric, the move is often 80% done. By the time despair sets in, bottom often forming. Sentiment is **timing signal for narrative phases**, not directional signal.\n\nMajor commercial products (FiinPro, Wichart, Stockbiz) don't provide this. It's labor-intensive and requires Vietnamese NLP — exactly what LLMs now enable.\n\n## A.2 Core Use Cases\n\n**UC-1 Pump Warning** — Alert when ticker shows pump signature: alert specifies suspected phase (pre-pump / pump / distribution / dump) with contributing signals and recommended action (avoid / exit / continue watching).\n\n**UC-2 Narrative Tracking** — Track narratives (e.g., \"đầu tư công 2026\", \"ngành thép phục hồi\") through lifecycle phases. Alert when narrative reaches saturation (likely top forming).\n\n**UC-3 Counter-Narrative Generator** — When a ticker reaches high sentiment (>80% bullish community), system auto-generates counter-narrative: what if this is wrong, what are bear cases, historical similar setups that failed.\n\n**UC-4 Sentiment Momentum on Watchlist** — Daily: which of my watchlist stocks have meaningful sentiment changes? (Crowd suddenly notices = late; crowd turning negative on one I own = signal.)\n\n**UC-5 FOMO Detection** — Detect when I'm about to FOMO — if I'm querying a ticker that's currently in saturation phase with high pump signals, system reminds me of pattern.\n\n## A.3 Business Rules\n\n**BR-1 Public Only** — Forums (F319 public section), public Facebook groups (non-restricted), public Telegram channels, article comments. **NEVER private groups, never Zalo private, never DMs.**","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":680}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4fb72df9-73a1-4a0c-adad-cc11d105d63c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

StockForge generates evaluation data through:\n47\t- Thesis outcomes (3-12 month review cycle)\n48\t- KOL recommendation outcomes (1-12 month cycle)\n49\t- Pump detection outcomes (30-90 days post-detection)\n50\t- Narrative phase predictions vs actual phase evolution"}]},"uuid":"afb7bbe6-16d5-404a-8634-bf16c975a3cb","timestamp":"2026-05-04T23:58:45.299Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\specs\\tier2-feature\\005-karpathy-outer-loop.md","content":"---\nspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-23-005\ntier: 2\nstatus: approved\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: 2026-04-23\nauthors: [project-owner]\nbounded_contexts: [Analysis, Calibration, Market Data]\nrelated_specs: [SPEC-2026-04-23-T1-001, SPEC-2026-04-23-004]\nubiquitous_language_terms: [Outer Loop, Editable Asset, Scalar Metric, Eval Set, Goodhart's Law, Ratchet, Simplicity Criterion, Meta-Optimization, Walk-Forward]\n---\n\n# SPEC: Karpathy Outer Loop — Pipeline Self-Optimization (Year 2)\n\n> Applies the Karpathy autoresearch pattern to optimize signal weights, prompts, and rules over time.\n> **This spec activates in Year 2.** Year 1 is calibration-data-accumulation; without sufficient data, outer loop has nothing to optimize against.\n\n---\n\n# PART A — BUSINESS SPECIFICATION\n\n## A.1 Context\n\nKarpathy's autoresearch loop: LLM agent edits an `editable_asset` repeatedly, each edit evaluated by a `scalar_metric`, within a `time_boxed_cycle`. Best results kept (ratchet), simpler solutions preferred (simplicity criterion).\n\nApplied to StockForge: **we don't optimize investment decisions directly** (that's Goodhart trap — LLM would learn to hack whatever metric we use). We optimize the **pipeline** that produces investment theses.\n\n**Editable assets**:\n- Signal weights in confluence engine\n- Prompt templates for perspective agents\n- Pump phase classifier thresholds\n- KOL credibility formula parameters\n- Narrative phase transition rules\n- Screening rules in watchlist\n\n**Scalar metrics** (on HOLD-OUT set, not used for tuning):\n- Thesis hit rate (primary)\n- Alert precision/recall\n- Pump detection precision/recall\n- KOL calibration CI width\n\n**Time-boxed cycle**: each \"experiment\" = re-run pipeline on historical period + measure metric, ~1-2 hours.\n\n## A.2 Why Year 2 Activation\n\nKarpathy loop requires **evaluation data**. StockForge generates evaluation data through:\n- Thesis outcomes (3-12 month review cycle)\n- KOL recommendation outcomes (1-12 month cycle)\n- Pump detection outcomes (30-90 days post-detection)\n- Narrative phase predictions vs actual phase evolution","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":621}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a5bc3f36-0acb-4fc3-8a1c-401bca2df601","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"8888373d-50f1-4857-9d73-cab8e3902d6d","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

Are we in autonomous mode?\n20\tEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\n21\tif [[ ! -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]]; then exit 0; fi\n22\tif ! grep -qE '^\\*\\*autonomous_mode\\*\\*:\\s*true' \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi\n23\t\n24\t# 2. Read Stop hook stdin (jq preferred; bash regex fallback for Windows-without-jq).\n25\tSTDIN_JSON=\"$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n26\tTRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"\"\n27\tSESSION_ID=\"\"\n28\tif [[ -n \"$STDIN_JSON\" ]]; then\n29\t  if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n30\t    TRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n31\t    SESSION_ID=\"$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n32\t  else\n33\t    if [[ \"$STDIN_JSON\" =~ \\\"transcript_path\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]+)\\\" ]]; then\n34\t      TRANSCRIPT_PATH=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\n35\t    fi\n36\t    if [[ \"$STDIN_JSON\" =~ \\\"session_id\\\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\\"([^\\\"]+)\\\" ]]; then\n37\t      SESSION_ID=\"${BASH_REMATCH[1]}\"\n38\t    fi\n39\t  fi\n40\tfi\n41\t\n42\t# 3. Inspect last assistant text for narration-as-action / API error / premature-windown.\n43\tNARRATION_HIT=\"\"\n44\tAPI_ERROR_HIT=\"\"\n45\tAPI_REQUEST_ID=\"\"\n46\tPREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT=\"\"\n47\tREAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS=\"\"\n48\tWIND_DOWN_MARKER=\"\"\n49\tif [[ -n \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" && -f \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" ]]; then\n50\t  LAST_TAIL=\"$(tail -c 8192 \"$TRANSCRIPT_PATH\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n51\t  # Failure mode A: narration verbs WITHOUT tool_use block in same tail.\n52\t  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qiE '(Dispatching|Now running|Now dispatching|Will dispatch|Will run|Awaiting (sandwich|task|spec|code|systematic|verifier|reviewer|implementer))' ; then\n53\t    if ! printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qE '\"type\":\"tool_use\"' ; then\n54\t      NARRATION_HIT=\"suspected\"\n55\t    fi\n56\t  fi\n57\t  # Failure mode B: Anthropic API error truncating stream.\n58\t  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qE '(overloaded_error|\"type\":\"error\".*\"Overloaded\"|rate_limit_error|api_error|\"status\":5[0-9][0-9])' ; then\n59\t    API_ERROR_HIT=\"suspected\"\n60\t    API_REQUEST_ID=\"$(printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -oE '\"request_id\":\"req_[A-Za-z0-9]+\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*\"\\(req_[A-Za-z0-9]*\\)\".*/\\1/')\"\n61\t  fi\n62\t  # Failure mode C: premature wind-down — wind-down language but real tokens < 200K and no marker.\n63\t  TOKENS_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/.transcript-tokens\"\n64\t  WIND_DOWN_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/.wind-down\"\n65\t  if [[ -f \"$TOKENS_FILE\" ]]; then\n66\t    REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS=\"$(tr -d '[:space:]' < \"$TOKENS_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n67\t  fi\n68\t  if [[ -f \"$WIND_DOWN_FILE\" ]]; then WIND_DOWN_MARKER=\"present\"; fi\n69\t  WIND_DOWN_LANGUAGE=\"\"\n70\t  if printf '%s' \"$LAST_TAIL\" | grep -qiE '(approaching.{0,20}(200K|wind-down|wind down)|past 150K|fresh envelope|fresh budget|writing checkpoint|ending turn cleanly|reboot.{0,30}(envelope|budget|next))' ; then\n71\t    WIND_DOWN_LANGUAGE=\"suspected\"\n72\t  fi\n73\t  if [[ \"$WIND_DOWN_LANGUAGE\" == \"suspected\" && -z \"$WIND_DOWN_MARKER\" && -n \"$REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS\" ]]; then\n74\t    if [[ \"$REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS < 180000 )); then\n75\t      PREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT=\"suspected\"\n76\t    fi\n77\t  fi\n78\tfi\n79\t\n80\t# 4. Append structured warning line.\n81\t{\n82\t  printf '[%s] STOP autonomous_mode=true session=%s narration_hit=%s api_error=%s request_id=%s premature_windown=%s real_tokens=%s wind_down_marker=%s transcript=%s\\n' \\\n83\t    \"$TS\" \"${SESSION_ID:-unknown}\" \"${NARRATION_HIT:-clean}\" \"${API_ERROR_HIT:-clean}\" \"${API_REQUEST_ID:-none}\" \"${PREMATURE_WINDOWN_HIT:-clean}\" \"${REAL_TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS:-unknown}\" \"${WIND_DOWN_MARKER:-absent}\" \"${TRANSCRIPT_PATH:-unknown}\"\n84\t} >> \"$WATCHDOG_LOG\"\n85\t\n86\t# 5. API-error alert.\n87\tif [[ \"$API_ERROR_HIT\" == \"suspected\" ]]; then\n88\t  ALERT_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/.autonomous-api-error-alert.log\"\n89\t  {\n90\t    printf '[%s] LIKELY API-TRUNCATION STOP. session=%s request_id=%s. Loop state may be inconsistent — re-derive next-action from checkpoints/latest.md before resuming.\\n' \\\n91\t      \"$TS\" \"${SESSION_ID:-unknown}\" \"${API_REQUEST_ID:-unknown}\"\n92\t  } >> \"$ALERT_FILE\"\n93\tfi\n94\t\n95\t# === Mode-B auto-recovery (under wind-down → continue-injector; over → reboot) ===\n96\tDRY_RUN=\"${STOCKFORGE_RECOVERY_DRY_RUN:-${ORCH_RECOVERY_DRY_RUN:-0}}\"\n97\tWIND_DOWN_THR=\"${STOCKFORGE_WIND_DOWN_TOKENS:-${ORCH_WIND_DOWN_TOKENS:-180000}}\"\n98\t\n99\tif [[ \"$API_ERROR_HIT\" == \"suspected\" ]]; then\n100\t  RECOVERY_KEY=\"${API_REQUEST_ID:-${SESSION_ID:-unknown}-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M)}\"\n101\t  RECOVERY_MARKER=\"$LOG_DIR/.api-truncation-recovery-fired-$RECOVERY_KEY\"\n102\t  if [[ ! -f \"$RECOVERY_MARKER\" ]]; then\n103\t    REAL_TOK=\"$(tr -d '[:space:]' < \"$LOG_DIR/.transcript-tokens\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\"\n104\t    [[ \"$REAL_TOK\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || REAL_TOK=0\n105\t\n106\t    if (( REAL_TOK >= WIND_DOWN_THR )); then\n107\t      RECOVERY_MODE=\"reboot\"\n108\t      RECOVERY_CMD=( bash \"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/session-self-reboot.sh\" )\n109\t    else\n110\t      if [[ -f \"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/continue-injector.ps1\" ]] && command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n111\t        RECOVERY_MODE=\"injector\"\n112\t        RECOVERY_CMD=( powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"$(cygpath -w \"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/continue-injector.ps1\" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' \"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/continue-injector.ps1\")\" )\n113\t      else\n114\t        RECOVERY_MODE=\"reboot-fallback\"\n115\t        RECOVERY_CMD=( bash \"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/session-self-reboot.sh\" )\n116\t      fi\n117\t    fi\n118\t\n119\t    mkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n120\t    {\n121\t      printf 'fired_at=%s\\nrequest_id=%s\\nsession=%s\\nreal_tokens=%s\\nmode=%s\\n' \\\n122\t        \"$TS\" \"${API_REQUEST_ID:-none}\" \"${SESSION_ID:-unknown}\" \"$REAL_TOK\" \"$RECOVERY_MODE\"\n123\t    } > \"$RECOVERY_MARKER\"\n124\t\n125\t    HANDOFF_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/handoff-logs/api-truncation-recovery-$(date +%s)-$RECOVERY_KEY.log\"\n126\t    mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$HANDOFF_LOG\")\"\n127\t    if [[ \"$DRY_RUN\" != \"1\" ]]; then\n128\t      timeout 8 \"${RECOVERY_CMD[@]}\" >> \"$HANDOFF_LOG\" 2>&1 || true\n129\t    fi\n130\t\n131\t    {\n132\t      printf '[%s] AUTO-RECOVERY FIRED. session=%s request_id=%s real_tokens=%s mode=%s marker=%s\\n' \\\n133\t        \"$TS\" \"${SESSION_ID:-unknown}\" \"${API_REQUEST_ID:-unknown}\" \"$REAL_TOK\" \"$RECOVERY_MODE\" \"$(basename \"$RECOVERY_MARKER\")\"\n134\t    } >> \"$LOG_DIR/.autonomous-api-error-alert.log\"\n135\t  fi\n136\tfi\n137\t\n138\t# 6.
